title: GM is giving OnStar an AI makeover | TechCrunch
summary: The new OnStar mobile app will replace the current OnStar Guardian app that launched in 2020 as well as vehicle brand apps for Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, and GMC. GM said it and OnStar cannot access Connected Camera recordings.
